policy: Clean prism C. Calibrate prism C only after the cleaning is verified.
Inspect drum 6 before rotating drum 6. Rotate drum 6 only after inspection.
Before cutting rope 9, measure rope 9 and label its ends.
The operator, after the sensor is checked, must close shutter 2.
Bind folio M when the archivist confirms that all leaves are dry.
If buoy 5 is damaged, report the fault; otherwise moor buoy 5.
Focus lens 7 and lock lens 7 before taking a photograph.
Before coating coupon B, verify coupon B's roughness. Coat coupon B after verification.
Raise mesh 3 only when the actuator works. Inspect mesh 3 before raising it again.
The controller must record cue X and then play cue X unless the channel is muted.
Never energize coil H while the panel remains open. Do not bypass the latch.
The crate that arrived yesterday must remain sealed until the inspector releases it.
